non_negotiable.title: Re-verify cross-domain cookie auth works in a real browser
non_negotiable.reason: The custom-domain fix was the highest-stakes Syntra bug of the week — multi-tenant SaaS where tenants get their own branded login URL. Two shipping sessions in 12 hours with parallel commits, force-pushes, and one missed git pull means the live state has not been independently confirmed by a human eyeball yet. If cookie drop on cross-origin redirect isn't actually fixed, every CYBERSLIDE user can't log in — that's a production incident waiting to be reported.
non_negotiable.action: Spend 10 minutes in the VNC browser: navigate to https://syntra.cyberslide.net/login, log in as a CYBERSLIDE user, confirm dashboard renders at syntra.cyberslide.net (not syntra.terrybot.top), hard-refresh and confirm session persists. If anything bounces to terrybot.top or shows the login page again, roll back to commit d5415c8b and open a fresh session — do NOT layer more fixes on unverified state.
